scripts.prebuild: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'index.html.source') { Copy-Item 'index.html.source' 'index.html' -Force; Write-Host 'Restored source index.html for build' }"
scripts.postbuild: powershell -Command "Copy-Item 'dist/index.html' 'index.html.built' -Force; Copy-Item 'index.html.source' 'index.html' -Force; Write-Host 'Built index.html saved as index.html.built, source restored'"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -File deploy.ps1
